definitions.explanation: Something that gives one motivation or encouragement to continue efforts.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{応援|おうえん}→応援：01900_ouen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{励|はげ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{笑顔|えがお}→笑顔：01884_egao⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{励|はげ}みだ。
examples.english: My children's smiles are my motivation at work.

examples.japanese: {励|はげ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ありがとう→ありがとう：00917_arigatou⟧。
examples.english: Thank you for the encouraging words.

notes:
RELATED VERB:
⟦{励|はげ}む→励む：11822_hagemu⟧ - to work hard, to strive
⟦{励|はげ}ます→励ます：05304_hagemasu⟧ - to encourage (someone)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {励|はげ}み⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ - to be encouraging/motivating
- {励|はげ}み⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ - to give encouragement
- ⟦{大|おお}きな→大きな：02849_ookina⟧{励|はげ}み - great encouragement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{張|は}り{合|あ}い→張り合い：07283_hariai⟧ - stimulation, motivation (from competition)
- やりがい - sense of fulfillment
- ⟦{動機|どうき}→動機：16028_douki⟧ - motive

USAGE:
{励|はげ}み emphasizes the encouragement aspect, giving someone strength to continue.
